clue.text: Plant in gale shaken about

indicators.note: things that are shaken get jumbled up, so the words before it are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
ca, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A plant being tossed about in a strong wind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' looks like part of the shaking, but it is the abbreviation CA tacked on after the rearranged letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Angelica is an aromatic herb whose candied stems are used in baking.

clue.text: Group of players following ace further

indicators.note: following means coming after, so this piece is placed after the other

blocks.note: A is the abbreviation for ace in cards
the LSO is the London Symphony Orchestra

explanation.surface: A team going one better after an ace serve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Players' suggests a sports team, but they are musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: Also and further both add another point, meaning in addition.

clue.text: Fifty in odd game getting frantic over large prize for winning

indicators.note: in places one item inside the following words
something frantic is wildly disordered, so the letters are thrown into a new order
in a down clue over means above, so this part comes before what follows

blocks.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
taken as written, to be rearranged
L is the abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A curious contest turns hectic with a big trophy at stake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Odd' looks like a description of the game, but it is part of the letters rearranged with L.
explanation.definitionFit: A gold medal is the award given for first place in a competition.

clue.text: Most recent US city experiment

blocks.note: LA is Los Angeles
a test is an experiment

explanation.surface: The newest trial run in an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Latest is a superlative meaning newest or most up to date.

clue.text: Bishop in association with knight in longing for authority

indicators.note: in places one letter inside a word, here used twice

blocks.note: a cartel is an association of businesses
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
to ache for is to long for
N is the chess abbreviation for knight

explanation.surface: A churchman allied with a knight, both yearning for power.
explanation.walkthrough: Bishop and knight suggest chess or the church; each is a one-letter abbreviation placed inside a word.
explanation.definitionFit: Carte blanche is complete freedom or unlimited licence to act as one wishes.

clue.text: Crown found in sea with relief brought back

indicators.note: bringing something back returns it the way it came, so the letters run right to left

blocks.note: the Med is the Mediterranean Sea
aid is help or relief

explanation.surface: A crown recovered from the sea and returned with relief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brought back' applies to the whole string, not just the second word; 'found in' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A diadem is a jewelled headband worn as a mark of royalty, a kind of crown.

clue.text: Exemption obtained by rascal with agreement

blocks.note: an imp is a mischievous rascal
unity is harmony or agreement

explanation.surface: A rogue gets let off by reaching a settlement.
explanation.definitionFit: Impunity is freedom from punishment, an exemption from consequences.

clue.text: Part of plot tidied up, the same as before

indicators.note: part of means a portion taken from inside the following words
in a down clue up means reading from bottom to top

blocks.note: the letters straddling the two words

explanation.surface: Tidying part of a garden plot just as before.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tidied up' reads as a phrase, but 'up' is the signal to read the hidden letters backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Ditto is used to say the same thing again as previously stated.

clue.text: Soup's sources sound about right

indicators.note: about means going around, so one word wraps a letter

blocks.note: mines are sources of minerals
a tone is a sound
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: The ingredients of a soup are reliable, it seems.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective meaning reliable, but it is the noun TONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Minestrone is a thick Italian vegetable soup with pasta.

clue.text: Mostly reliable sailor with yen to be alone

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter of the word is dropped

blocks.note: solid means dependable or reliable
tar is a traditional word for a sailor
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: A dependable seaman who longs for his own company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yen' reads as a longing, but here it is the currency, abbreviated to Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Solitary describes someone on their own, without companions.

clue.text: Accurate child receives prize

indicators.note: one who receives something holds it, so one word goes inside the other

blocks.note: a son is a child
a pot is a trophy cup or a pool of winnings

explanation.surface: A precise youngster gets an award.
explanation.definitionFit: Spot on is an informal idiom meaning exactly right or precise.

clue.text: Skip college, excited to get hold of new instrument

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so the letters are mixed
getting hold of something means grasping it within, so one letter goes inside

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A student cuts classes, thrilled to acquire a new instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Skip college' reads as truancy, but its letters plus N are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A glockenspiel is a percussion instrument of tuned metal bars struck with hammers.

clue.text: Varied music one's playing, including Fitzgerald?

indicators.note: playing music means performing it in a new arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, apostrophe dropped
Ella Fitzgerald, the jazz singer

explanation.surface: A mixed programme of songs that features Ella Fitzgerald.
explanation.walkthrough: Ella's name is added to the letters of MUSIC ONE'S before the whole lot is mixed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Miscellaneous describes a collection of assorted, diverse kinds of things.

clue.text: Artificial distortion of short alien in film

indicators.note: distortion twists shape, so the next word's letters are rearranged
in places these letters inside a word

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
ET is the alien from the Spielberg film
pic is short for picture, a film

explanation.surface: A fake effect makes a small extraterrestrial look odd on screen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' seems to describe the alien, but it is the word whose letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A prosthetic limb or part is an artificial replacement for a body part.

clue.text: In hearing, regretted being impertinent

indicators.note: in hearing means as it strikes the ear, so we want a word that sounds like another

blocks.note: rued means regretted

explanation.surface: Someone at a court hearing regrets being cheeky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In hearing' suggests a courtroom, but it only signals the sound-alike.
explanation.definitionFit: Rude and impertinent both describe cheeky, disrespectful behaviour.

clue.text: Structure highly indicative of the present time

definitions.text: Structure highly indicative of the present time

blocks.clueFragment: Structure highly indicative of the present time
blocks.note: surface reading: a building that strongly typifies modern times

blocks.clueFragment: highly indicative of the present time
blocks.note: setter's reading: a building that shows the current hour from high up

explanation.walkthrough: 'Highly' seems to mean 'very', and 'the present time' seems to mean our era; read literally, it is a tall building showing the hour.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall building with a timepiece set high on it tells passers-by what hour it is.

clue.text: Something worn and old in attic was thrown out

indicators.note: in places one letter inside the following words
things thrown out are scattered in disorder, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: O is the abbreviation for old
taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: An old garment in the loft was discarded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Something worn and old' reads as a tatty item, but the definition stops at 'worn'.
explanation.definitionFit: A waistcoat is a sleeveless garment worn over a shirt.

clue.text: Magnificent tune rising in force

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means going upward, so the word is read from bottom to top
in places one word inside another

blocks.note: to impel is to force
an air is a tune

explanation.surface: A grand melody swelling powerfully.
explanation.definitionFit: Imperial means grand and majestic, befitting an empire or emperor.

clue.text: Son tormented an alarmed amphibian

indicators.note: something tormented is twisted and agitated, so the following letters are rearranged

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for son
taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A boy teases a frightened newt-like creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A salamander is a lizard-shaped amphibian related to newts.

clue.text: Wrong about good omen

indicators.note: about means going around, so one word wraps the other

blocks.note: a sin is a wrong
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: Something bad turned out to be a favourable portent.
explanation.definitionFit: A sign is a portent or indication of what is to come.

clue.text: Conclusion not yet decided?  No pressure

indicators.note: no means without, so the letter it names is removed

blocks.note: pending means awaiting a decision
P is the abbreviation for pressure

explanation.surface: An unresolved outcome, with nobody being pushed.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark hints that the definition is next to wordplay that reads like a description of it.
explanation.definitionFit: An ending is the final part or close of something.

clue.text: Nag crazy person to protect box tree

indicators.note: to protect something is to surround and shield it, so one word goes around another

blocks.note: a nag is an old horse
a nut is a crazy person
a chest is a box

explanation.surface: Pester a madman to guard a box-tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nag' looks like a verb and 'box tree' like one plant, but box is CHEST and the tree alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The horse chestnut is a large tree that bears conkers.

clue.text: Set compass and wander

blocks.note: first meaning: scope or extent
second meaning: to roam freely

explanation.walkthrough: 'Set compass' sounds like navigating before a hike; 'Set' is a third sense of the same word, as in a set or line of goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Range is a noun for scope or extent and a verb for roaming over a wide area.

clue.text: Tips from witch expertly creating watery liquid

indicators.note: tips are the two ends of something, so only the outside letters of each word are kept

blocks.note: first and last letters
first and last letters

explanation.surface: A witch skilfully brewing a thin potion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tips' might suggest first letters only, but both ends of each word are needed.
explanation.definitionFit: Whey is the thin liquid left after milk curdles and the curds are removed.

clue.text: Second during final round in game

indicators.note: turning something round makes it face the other way, so the letters are read backwards

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for second
in means during, as in 'in the night'
net means final, as in a net price after deductions

explanation.surface: A second spent in the last round of a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Final round' looks like the last stage of a tournament, but 'round' alone is the signal. Net means final as in a price after all deductions.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennis is a racket game played over a net.

clue.text: Energy in call by hard member of tribe

indicators.note: in places one word inside another

blocks.note: to call on someone is to visit
go means energy or vigour
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A vigorous summons from a tough tribesman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Energy' is usually E in cryptics, but here it is GO, as in 'full of go'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Visigoths were the western branch of the Goths, a Germanic people.

clue.text: Porter for instance carrying on in language

indicators.note: carrying something means holding it inside, so one word goes within another

blocks.note: Cole Porter, the American songwriter
re means on, concerning

explanation.surface: A railway porter carries on talking in a foreign tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Porter' suggests a luggage carrier, but it is the composer, so his first name is wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: A creole is a language formed from the mixing of two or more tongues.

clue.text: A little match in secret

indicators.note: in places one word inside another

blocks.note: on the sly means in secret
a match gives a light

explanation.surface: A small match played behind closed doors.
explanation.definitionFit: Slightly is an adverb meaning to a small degree.
